description: This file is a shell script containing a series of test cases for Git's 'rev-list' command. It defines various scenarios and assertions to verify correct behavior of Git's revision listing functionalities, including options like --objects, --no-object-names, --header, --count, --z, and more.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting it to succeed, takes a description and a block of shell commands to execute as the test scenario.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or state to simulate passage of time between commits.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to execute after the test completes.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit for testing, potentially with a specific message or within a specific directory.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output, asserting they are identical.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks that the number of lines in a file or output matches an expected count.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a specified path does not exist.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Asserts that the output or file is empty.

methods.name: nul_to_q
methods.description: Converts null characters in output to a specific placeholder or format for testing.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
